purpose: ORG-derived experimental growth of standalone filled rectangles, with intact contours, circle keep-out, a 1.25x ceiling, and the full original side-by-side trace gap reserved in T02.
eligibility: Standalone filled F.Cu source polygon with exact supported geometry, four unique vertices, adjacent perpendicular edges, and equal opposing sides. The complete 1.25x per-axis growth envelope must fit inside the registered crop; otherwise preserve the whole source shape unchanged. Retain exact source spans and do not infer pad or net identity.
factor_basis: Owner-directed bounded experiment with a hard 1.25x ceiling on each source-local axis; not a manufacturing sizing rule.
contour_rule: Every proposal remains one complete rectangle in the source-local axes. Original and T01 circle occupancy plus the 0.02002 mm construction gap is protected; neighboring copper may limit either growth axis, but must never carve, recess, notch, or round a rectangular contour.

side_trace_gap_reservation.definition: Circle and rectangle growth is handled in T02 before any trace task. For nearby ORG F.Cu traces, preserve max(minimum_retained_gap_mm, 0.5 * measured_ORG_gap) in the general case. For a native straight segment that geometrically runs alongside the central portion of a rectangle side (axis within 15 degrees), preserve the full measured ORG gap. This distinction reserves the full side-by-side corridor and avoids treating every trace direction as side-by-side. Trace geometry is unchanged in T02. A later trace task may consider bending or narrowing only at explicitly classified local corner or curved-circle interactions; this is not a universal rule and side-by-side cases are excluded. The interaction classifier and adjustment bound remain unresolved. Do not claim any future trace adjustment is qualified or already performed.
side_trace_gap_reservation.future_trace_growth: DEFERRED; only a future explicitly classified corner or curved-circle interaction may be considered; no universal trace adjustment; side-by-side excluded; trigger and adjustment bounds unresolved

side_by_side_classifier.nearest_contact_projection: within central 80 percent of the contacted rectangle side
side_by_side_classifier.curved_arc_behavior: not classified as side-by-side; uses the general fraction

scene_update: Deterministic source-center Y, X, then source-identity order. Each proposal sees all original F.Cu, the complete accepted T01 scene, prior accepted T02 additions, and minimum-gap trace reservations. Original source copper remains unchanged.
protected: the complete accepted T01 scene and its round priorities
accepted T01 square-recess or negative geometry when explicitly represented; otherwise its accepted neighborhood remains no-write protected
limitations: Source graphics do not supply a native pad/net identity or prove a trace-to-land electrical relationship.
The selected crop uses a screenshot locator with at least 0.0223 mm raster uncertainty.
No electrical, native-export, manufacturing, or EDIT-equivalence claim is made.

T02 reserves the full ORG gap only for classified side-by-side rectangle/segment interactions; other nearby trace interactions use the 0.5 ORG-gap floor. A future corner or curved-circle trace adjustment is localized and unqualified; this is not a manufacturing rule.
